title: Gilas Pilipinas accepts criticisms after failed bid to defend Asian Games gold
summary: A Gilas Pilipinas coach on Wednesday acknowledged that they had disappointed the Filipino basketball fans after an ignominious end to their title defense in the Asian Games.
